items.title: Construction of a quaternionic modified universal Kolyvagin system for a Hida family from big Heegner classes
items.author: Francesco Zerman
items.difficulty_reason: The main construction performs quaternionic Kolyvagin descent across finite quotients of the universal anticyclotomic Hida representation, checks local Selmer conditions and norm/finite-singular relations, and introduces compatible modifying automorphisms to obtain the original modified universal system. All five original assumptions and exact first term retained. Old181141 only gives infinitude of a finer prime set1124–1155, one support step; the full derivative/cohomological descent and modification are additional nonroutine content. The author explicitly does not identify the modified system with a classical one, and the later Iwasawa conclusion is only one divisibility under its original nonzero/regularity conditions; both limitations preserved. No independent math certification or computation rerun.
